这个男孩子叫孟子，孟子是古代的人。孟子的妈妈觉得住在哪儿对童年很重要，所以他们常常搬了家。孟子的妈妈望子成龙，所以安排他的生活。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他们常常搬了家” / Formula: Subject + 常常 + V. + Object; use 了 for a completed single event, not a habitual action / Correct: “所以她们常常搬家。” “常常” describes a repeated habit, so do not add “了.” Also, because this refers to Mencius and his mother, “她们” is more precise than “他们.”

items.reason: “常常”表示习惯性动作，应说“常常搬家”，但孟子是男性，和母亲合称不能改成“她们”，应保留“他们”。
